from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

# Define correct qubit/clbit dimensions based on the user request
num_qubits = 5
num_clbits = 2
qc = QuantumCircuit(num_qubits, num_clbits)

# Apply H gate to qubits 0 and 1
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)

# Apply Rz(2.8507) to qubit 0 and Rz(0.2836) to qubit 1
qc.rz(2.8507, 0)
qc.rz(0.2836, 1)

# Apply CNOT from qubit 0 to qubit 1
qc.cx(0, 1)

# Apply Rz(1.6627) to qubit 1 (ZZ interaction angle)
qc.rz(1.6627, 1)

# Apply CNOT from qubit 0 to qubit 1
qc.cx(0, 1)

# Repeat Steps 1-5 exactly once more (second ZZ layer)
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.rz(2.8507, 0)
qc.rz(0.2836, 1)
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.rz(1.6627, 1)
qc.cx(0, 1)

# Measure qubits 0 and 1 using qc.measure([0, 1], [0, 1])
qc.measure([0, 1], [0, 1])
